tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyun gyi nyams len bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī bhya:

'dir bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i gser chos las byung ba'i rgyun khyer sgrub thabs ni/ 'byor na mdun du sman raka gtor ma nyer spyod dang bcas pa bsham/ tshogs zhing gsal btab la/ kyai: phyogs bcu'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog bdag la dgongs: 'gro rnams skyob pa'i mgon dang dpung mdzod cig: dus 'di nas bzung rdzogs sangs ma rgyas bar: mgon po mchog gyur rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag gzhan lus dang longs spyod mchod par 'bul: nyams chag nyes ltung bsags rnams mthol zhing bshags: dus gsum dge bar gyur la rjes yi rang: bla med theg chen chos 'khor bskor du gsol: rgyal ba mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol: bdag gzhan dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo: skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnams la skyabs su mchi: sngon chad rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rmad byung ltar: de bzhin bdag gis dus 'di nas brtsam bya: 'gro ba yongs kyi bla mar bdag gyur cig: ces pas rgyud sbyangs te tshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa yod na bsang sbyang*/ oṃ: snang srid 'dod yon longs spyod mchod pa'i rdzas: ā: rnam dag lha tshogs dgyes pa skong bar byed: hūm̐: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya nus bcud ldan: ho: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bla na med: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: zhes byin gyis brlab/ bdag bskyed ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ stong pa nyid dang snying rje che'i rang bzhin// zung 'jug hrīḥlas rgyu yi he ru ka /ma 'gag rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas khang*// dwangs gsal 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i klong yangs su// rang rig padma badzra dmar gsal mdangs// dmar mthing dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis// rdor dril ral gri bhañdza bum pa dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin lha lcam gsang ba'i yum// dmar mo ḍā ru dung dmar 'dzin dang sbyor// gar dgu'i nyams ldan 'bar ba'i chas kyis brjid// buddha thod phreng mi bskyod rdo rje rtsal// padma dbang chen rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal// mdog dmar me phreng sangs rgyas dpa' bo dang*// rta mgrin phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa// rang rang yum 'khor bka' nyan sprul par bcas// rnam rol ma 'gag sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sprin// gang 'dul mos pa'i dpal du lham mer gsal/

hūm̐ hrī: rang byung thugs rje ma 'gag rol pa'i sku: spyan 'dren bzhugs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang: thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos skur dag pa las: rtsal snang dbyings nas rol cing gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya e ā ralli hrīng hrīng: pheṃ pheṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: tsitta badzra dzñā na padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ: a ti pū ho: pra tītstsha ho: hūm̐ hrī: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: me tog bdug spos mar me zhal zas dri: sgra dbyangs arghaṃ la sogs mchod pa'i sprin: phyi nang gsang ba bla med dgyes mchod 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī arghaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bidyā shabda pū dza ho: rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pū dza ho: ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ nai ri ti ba su ta tsitta pū dza ho: bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa a mṛta rakta ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐ hrī: phyi nang gzhan gsum lha dang lha mo'i tshogs: byed pa kun ston rnam 'phrul yongs kyi mdzod: 'khor 'das rang grol bde chen g.yung drung sku: dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzlas dmigs ni/ lha tshogs thugs kar pad zla nyi steng hrī: /sngags phreng bskor ba'i 'od kyis don gnyis byas// snod bcud rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i zhing du gyur// tshur 'dus mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadzra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ ā: zhes dgongs 'dus rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa spyi dril 'bring po ci nus bzla/ shes shing spro na spyi dril chen mo dang gtso dgu'i snying po sogs kyang bzla chog /lus dkyil byed na ngag bzlas de dag gtsor mi byed par 'bru gsum rlung dang sbyar ba'i rdor bzlas bya/

gang ltar yang mjug tu mchod bstod mdor bsdus/ kha skong dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying brjod/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'od gsal chos nyid du bsdu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyis slar rang byung gnyug ma'i lhar ldang*/ snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rol par bltas la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs su gsol// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyis// sgo gsum gyis bsags dge ba ji snyed pa// byang chub chen po'i dbyings su bsngo bar bgyi// bla med don gyi 'bras bu mchog thob shog / ces bsngo smon bya'o// zhes chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa dang kun gzigs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa'i rgyun khyer la slar yang gzhug mthud kyis gsal bar byed pa po padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas so// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: badzra gu ru padma siddhi dhe wa dhā ki nī: bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha: badzra ma hā kro dha shānti ka: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya sarba siddhi: kā ya wā ka tsitta: dzñā na satwa a mi dhe wa: ma ma tsitta saṃ bha wa a dhiṣṭhā naṃ: ma ma ā yurdzñā na siddhi pha la hūm̐ swā hā: spyi dril chen mo'o// //
